description: A relation \(R\subseteq\mathbb N^k\), including zero input arity, is decidable exactly when there is one arithmetic formula with \(Q\)-proofs of every true numerical instance and \(Q\)-proofs of the negations of every false numerical instance.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.recursive_relation_iff {n : ℕ} (R : (Fin n → ℕ) → Prop) :
  ComputablePred R ↔ ∃ A, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.SignedRepresents R A
